author: Wagler, 1829
summary: 해마다 수천 마리가 찾아와 번식하는 여름철새로, 여러 습지의 얕은 물가에서 먹이를 사냥한다. 다른 백로류의 번식 집단에 섞여 무리 지어 번식한다. 국외에서는 일본, 중국 남부, 동남아시아, 호주, 인도, 아프리카에 걸쳐 분포한다.

art.subject: Medium Egret (Ardea intermedia), adult in breeding plumage, as seen in Korea from May to July: plumage entirely white, with long, fine, hair-like plumes falling from the back beyond the tail tip and a shorter tuft of similar plumes on the lower foreneck and breast; no nape plumes. Bill black for most of its length, with a variable amount of yellow at the base; bare lores yellow to yellowish-green. Iris yellow. The gape line ends below the eye, not behind it. Legs and feet black.
art.pose: wading slowly in shallow water, stalking prey
art.scene: Korean summer wetland: shallow marsh edge with reeds and open water; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding (May–July), side view standing: all white, fine filamentous plumes on the breast and long back plumes past the tail, black bill with some yellow at the base, gape ending below the eye, black legs
adult non-breeding (August–September), side view standing: all white without plumes, yellow bill with a black tip, black legs and feet
art.build: Medium-large white egret, about 65cm, clearly bigger than a Little Egret and much smaller than a Great Egret. Rounded head with a steep forehead; neck medium-long, held in a smooth S without the sharp kink of Great Egret. Bill straight and rather short and stout for an egret, about as long as the head. Legs long and black, with bare tibia. At rest the wingtips reach about the tail tip, with breeding plumes hanging past it. In flight neck retracted and legs projecting beyond the tail, with quicker wingbeats than Great Egret.
avoid: Do not extend the gape line behind the eye — that is Great Egret, which is also much larger with a longer, kinked neck.
Do not paint yellow feet (Little Egret) or pale tibiae; legs are black in all seasons.
Do not paint two long nape plumes (Little Egret) or orange-buff plumes (Cattle Egret).
Do not paint a long, slender dagger bill much longer than the head.
